bias.en: Uptrend under pressure · bounced off the 100-day to the 10-day
bias.zh: 承压上升趋势 · 自 100 日均线反弹至 10 日均线

read.en: Nvidia rose 2.5% on Oct 21 to $221.97, trading between $217.66 and $222.19. It is above the falling 5-day ($217.4) and rising 100-day ($214.6) and 200-day ($203.4) averages, and just under the falling 10-day ($222.3) and 30-day ($224.5). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and is below zero, with the histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 13 ($235.14), and RSI is 48.
read.zh: 英伟达 10月21日上涨 2.5%，收于 $221.97，盘中区间 $217.66–222.19。股价位于下行的 5 日（$217.4）以及上行的 100 日（$214.6）和 200 日均线（$203.4）上方，略低于下行的 10 日（$222.3）和 30 日均线（$224.5）。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月13日起看空（$235.14），RSI 为 48。

read.en: The close cleared $218–219.6 (5-day average, Oct 19 and 20 highs), which now becomes support. Resistance is $222.2–224.5 (day's high, 10 and 30-day averages), then $226 (Oct 14 high) and $235.1 (SAR). Support is $217.4–219.6, then $214.6 (100-day) and $212.8 (Oct 15 and 20 lows). A close above $224.5 would open $226–235; a close below $214.6 would reopen $212.8.
